details.gpu_style: user-image compact single-fan dual-slot card; fan faces perforated side panel and dual-slot bracket faces rear service panel
details.psu: standard SFX power supply, envelope 125 x 100 x 63.5 mm, mounted horizontally along the case bottom with its long axis across the case width; rear panel provides the standard SFX 4-hole mounting flange (M4 screws) and AC inlet aperture; bottom load-bearing support rails carry the PSU front end; no additional internal cradle
details.layout: Mini-ITX enclosure with a conventional rear-panel dual-slot GPU bracket position and a bottom-mounted standard SFX PSU; no printed GPU support parts, PCIe riser assembly, or riser mounting hardware
details.storage: M.2 only; no separate drive bays
details.ventilation: large perforated side panels; no front ventilation
details.front_panel: solid removable magnetic panel with power-button opening only
details.panel_fit: front, rear, left and right panels extend flush between the top cap and base with no exposed inner-frame gaps
details.perimeter_panel_retention: tool-less magnetic retention for front, left and right panels only; rear panel uses four M3 socket-cap screws into the two rear columns
details.magnet_spec: 10 x 10 x 3 mm square countersunk magnet in a 10.2 x 10.2 x 3.2 mm pocket cut directly into each corner post, retained by one centered M3 countersunk screw; no separate carrier or external frame; four stations each for front, left and right panels, 12 total; no rear-panel magnets
details.rear_panel_mounting: four M3 socket-cap screws, upper and lower on each rear column; rear magnet pockets removed; screws and all mounting features clear motherboard, dual-slot GPU and PSU service apertures
details.psu_mounting: SFX PSU mounted horizontally at the case bottom via the rear-panel standard SFX flange (4 x M4, standard hole pattern) plus bottom support rails under the PSU front; AC inlet and fan face the rear panel; no separate printed cradle

notes: User requires only a conventional dual-slot GPU mounting position in the rear panel. All printed GPU supports are removed. PSU changed from compact 1U/Flex to standard SFX (125 x 100 x 63.5 mm) mounted horizontally at the case bottom: rear panel carries the standard SFX 4-hole M4 mounting flange and AC inlet aperture, and bottom support rails carry the PSU front end. The <=4.0 L volume target is relaxed per user decision; actual volume is reported from the final layout. GPU concept envelope remains 180 x 115 x 40 mm.
